name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns immediately, with no logic of its own. It only forwards control.

name: invoke_routine_twice
description: Calls another routine two times in succession and then returns. It is reached through a handler pointer stored in data, and eleven separate routines call it.

name: normalize_cross_product_components
description: Takes the differences between three pairs of 16-bit coordinates, forms cross-product components shifted down by twelve bits, and divides each by a scale value returned from another routine. The scale defaults to one when it is zero, and the results are stored into a fixed block of words.

name: save_restore_copy_eight_words
description: Saves one 16-bit field, calls another routine, restores the field, and sets a second field to its negation before calling a routine again. It then copies eight 16-bit words from one block into another and clears a flag word.

name: compute_counter_delta_and_record
description: Subtracts the last stored 32-bit counter value from the current one to get an elapsed delta, which is zeroed when a state word is negative. It keeps the largest delta above 500 units, and when a flag is set or another is clear it stores four word constants, calls routines and returns the delta.

name: run_routine_under_two_modes
description: When a flag word is set or another is clear, it saves a mode longword, sets it to one constant and calls a routine, then sets it to a second constant and calls it again. It restores the saved mode longword afterwards.

name: set_parameter_block_and_run
description: Stores four constant 16-bit parameters into fixed slots of a state block, then calls two routines in sequence.

name: run_guarded_mode_command_sequence
description: When one flag word is clear and a status bit is not set, it saves two state longwords and sends a command with a table-driven argument under one mode constant. It then runs a second mode sequence with two more routine calls and restores the saved state.

name: chain_two_routine_calls
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns. It has no other logic.

name: transform_point_list_to_arrays
description: Computes up to 128 points by multiplying each position from a rotation-indexed table by three rows of a fixed matrix and shifting the sums down by sixteen bits, storing each coordinate into its own array. A second pass compares the stored values against a threshold and checks neighbouring entries.

name: insert_pointer_into_sorted_table
description: Returns immediately when a status flag is set. Otherwise it stores a pointer into the first free slot of a four-entry table, starting from an index derived from a word, then bubble-sorts the table in ascending order by a 32-bit key.

name: shift_two_entry_history
description: Subtracts 32 from a word field, calls another routine, and moves the second and third halfwords of two structures down one slot each. It then calls one of two routines, chosen by whether the low four bits of a data register are zero.

name: choose_routine_by_low_nibble
description: Calls one of two routines depending on whether the low four bits of a data register are zero. It does nothing else.

name: scale_level_and_dispatch
description: Returns early when a status word is nonzero or a level value is negative. Otherwise it maps the level into the range 75 to 127, calls five routines, clamps the stored value to 127, and jumps through one of two handler pointers chosen by comparing two computed values.

name: send_gated_command_variant_a
description: When five status fields have the expected values, it sets a mode longword to one constant, sends a fixed command with one constant parameter to a routine, switches the mode to a second constant, and calls a routine to finish.

name: send_gated_command_variant_b
description: When five status fields have the expected values, it sets a mode longword to one constant, sends a fixed command with a different constant parameter to a routine, switches the mode to a second constant, and calls a routine to finish.

name: send_gated_command_variant_c
description: When five status fields have the expected values, it sets a mode longword to one constant, sends the same command with a third constant parameter, switches the mode to a second constant, and calls a routine to finish.

name: send_gated_command_variant_d
description: When five status fields have the expected values, it sets a mode longword to one constant, sends the same command with a fourth constant parameter, switches the mode to a second constant, and calls a routine to finish.

name: copy_audio_tables_update_volume
description: Sets a sentinel field, computes a new value for one of four channel slots, and copies eight words from a source block into three per-slot tables and sixty words into a fourth. It counts down a per-slot counter, and when that reaches zero it doubles the counter, negates it at a limit and reloads it with eight; the audio channel three volume register is touched.

name: toggle_paired_flag_words
description: If a flag word is set, it toggles a pair of words between zero and twelve and writes twelve into three longword slots when turning on. Otherwise it toggles one word at an offset given by a field.

name: loop_until_status_clear
description: Repeatedly calls one routine and, while its byte result is nonzero, calls a second routine, stopping once the result is zero. It is reached through a handler pointer in data, and five routines call it.

name: initialize_position_table_defaults
description: Stores a set of default 16-bit values into a state block, including two small counters and four further words, then copies two of those words into two later slots.

name: initialize_display_state_defaults
description: Sets a group of status and limit variables to fixed starting values, including 320 and 200 as limits, and takes a snapshot of the frame counter. It then calls several routines and makes an indirect call through a jump table pointer.

name: load_options_screen_and_reset
description: Clears a large block of game state variables and sets default limits and counters, then loads the options screen view. The options artwork file is referenced, and the display is switched with the graphics library's view loader after forty routine calls.

name: run_two_sequential_steps
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, with no other logic.

name: draw_tuneup_digit_when_active
description: Calls two routines, then either calls one more routine when a flag is clear or writes a one-based digit as a character into a text buffer at a position chosen by an index before making that call. The tune-up artwork file is referenced.

name: run_paired_mode_sequences
description: Stores two mode longwords and points two slots at the default data block, then calls several routines for one mode. It switches the mode longword to a second constant and repeats part of the sequence, calling one more routine only when a flag is set.

name: reset_screen_and_load_view
description: Sets sprite-like fields to sentinel values and resets a set of limits and counters, then makes an indirect call through a jump table pointer. Two entries are pointed at a default data block, and the display is switched with the graphics library's view loader.

name: poll_and_cycle_indices
description: Waits until a routine returns zero, then polls a result code in a loop. A value of one advances a counter that wraps after four, a value of two advances a counter that wraps after two, and a value of four decrements a counter that resets to two when it goes negative. The loop returns when a status field is set or the code is zero or negative; the tune-up artwork file is referenced.

name: poll_indices_unreached_gap
description: Sets a counter to one or two depending on the low bit of a register, then repeatedly polls a routine result and advances indices with the same exit test as its neighbours. It is reached from only one routine and decodes from a gap, so it may partly be data.

name: reset_secondary_mode_and_run
description: Points a secondary mode pointer at the default data block, sets the mode longword to one constant, and calls five routines in sequence.

name: compute_scaled_bar_geometry
description: Derives six display values from a table entry and two stored fields, clamping each input to 17, scaling by a divisor of 35, and writing the results into layout fields. It also sets one more field depending on a state word.

name: advance_row_and_copy_block
description: When two flags are clear, it sets a status flag, advances a row counter capped at 14 and a position field by 9, then copies five-byte segments from a six-byte-stride table into a buffer for each of eleven rows. Otherwise it calls three routines and branches to a common exit.

name: sort_slots_by_word_key
description: Stores a fixed table of four index-and-offset word pairs, then bubble-sorts the table in ascending order by a 16-bit field in the structure each index selects. It records the leading index in a state word afterwards.

name: copy_text_rows_into_buffer
description: Calls four routines, then for four entries copies nine characters per entry from a text table into a display buffer, turning zero bytes into spaces. It also stores a value taken from a structure field beside each row; the name text block is referenced.

name: run_result_dispatch_loop
description: Initializes two state words and makes a fixed sequence of routine calls, then loops reading a result code. A specific sentinel code ends the loop with its own return value, a negative result is stored into a state field and returned, and the other codes advance counters or call routines.

name: conditionally_call_for_value_five
description: Calls three routines, calls a fourth only when a register argument equals five, and then calls one more routine.

name: run_alternate_parameter_block
description: Stores four constant parameters of 1, 13, 10 and 113 into a state block, then calls one routine under one mode constant and a second routine under another, restoring the mode longword afterwards.

name: send_pair_of_block_commands
description: Under one mode constant, it sends two commands that take the current state value, a constant index of six and a constant of 124 with a data block pointer. It then switches to a second mode constant, calls two routines, and restores the saved mode.

name: forward_single_call_stub
description: Calls one other routine and returns, adding nothing of its own.

name: render_two_digit_number
description: Splits a value into tens and units digits in a two-byte buffer and calls a routine to fetch a character code. When the code falls in a valid range it copies bit-pattern bytes for each digit from a lookup table into a display area.

name: run_two_mode_call_sequence
description: Stores the current mode longword, calls two routines under one mode constant, then switches to a second mode constant to call two more. It restores the saved mode afterwards.

name: pass_through_single_call
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no logic of its own.

name: relay_single_routine_call
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no logic of its own.

name: call_three_steps_keep_result
description: Calls three routines in sequence and returns the data register value that was present on entry, unchanged.

name: set_two_blocks_and_run
description: Stores four 16-bit values into a position table and four parameters into a state block, then calls two routines. The data register value present on entry is returned unchanged.

name: set_two_blocks_run_alt
description: Stores four 16-bit values into a position table and four different parameters into a state block, then calls two routines. The data register value present on entry is returned unchanged.

name: poll_event_until_timeout
description: Records a starting timestamp, then loops calling routines and examining an event code. It returns a sentinel value when no event arrives within about eighteen thousand timer ticks, and it waits for the video frame using the graphics library's wait call.

name: stub_return_negative_one
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else. It is reached only from a gap in the decoded code.

name: read_digit_and_reset_state
description: Converts a character code into a digit and stores it in a state word, then resets a block of status and limit variables to fixed starting values, including 320 and 200 as limits. It calls several routines, and it is reached only from a gap in the decoded code.

name: clear_flag_after_two_calls
description: Calls two routines in sequence, then sets a flag word to zero.

name: set_flag_after_two_calls
description: Calls two routines in sequence, then sets a flag word to minus one.

name: poll_input_and_set_flag
description: Repeatedly calls routines to wait for the video frame and read input codes. An input code of seven sets a flag word to one, and a code of twenty-eight sets it to minus one, until a stop condition ends the loop.

name: read_menu_key_selection
description: Reads a key code and returns minus one when it is a quit key. Otherwise a digit below twelve selects an entry and draws it at a row computed from that digit; it is reached only from a gap in the decoded code, so it may be partial.

name: stub_return_negative_one_gap
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else. It is reached only from a gap in the decoded code.

name: call_table_entry_when_ready
description: Reads two words from a table entry chosen by an index, and when the flag word for that index is not negative it sets the mode longword to one constant, calls a routine with the two words, switches to a second mode constant, and calls another routine.

name: call_alt_table_when_ready
description: Reads two words from an alternate table entry chosen by an index, and when the flag word for that index is not negative it sets the mode longword to one constant, calls a routine with the two words, switches to a second mode constant, and calls another routine.

name: call_table_entry_guarded
description: Reads two words from a table entry chosen by an index, and when the flag word for that index is not negative it sets the mode longword to one constant, calls a routine with the two words, switches to a second mode constant, and calls another routine.

name: call_alt_table_entry_guarded
description: Reads two words from an alternate table entry chosen by an index, and when the flag word for that index is not negative it sets the mode longword to one constant, calls a routine with the two words, switches to a second mode constant, and calls another routine.

name: repeat_call_count_times
description: Calls one routine repeatedly, once for each step of a counter that starts at the input value and counts down through zero. It is reached only from a gap in the decoded code.

name: format_elapsed_time_text
description: Computes elapsed time from a stored timer snapshot, splits it into two-digit fields, and writes them as characters with a colon separator into a fixed text buffer.

name: send_pending_command_once
description: When a pending flag is set and two state checks pass, it clears the flag, stores four parameters, and sends them as a command under one mode constant. It then switches to a second mode constant and calls a routine.

name: send_command_with_fixed_params
description: Stores four fixed parameters and sends them as a command under one mode constant, then switches to a second mode constant and calls a routine.

name: schedule_timed_event_offsets
description: Under a guard on several state flags, it stores the current timer value, marks a pending flag, adds fixed tick offsets, stores a set of position-table words and calls routines. It waits for the video frame with the graphics library's wait call.

name: set_block_and_call_library
description: When a status bit is clear, it stores four position-table words and four parameters, makes a library call if a flag is set, and then calls two more routines.

name: copy_text_token_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from a text stream into a buffer until it reaches a terminator, a carriage return, a space or an end marker, starting from a stored position and width, then calls a routine.

name: set_text_params_and_copy
description: Derives four layout parameters from stored position words and calls a routine, then copies bytes from a text stream into a buffer until a terminator, carriage return, space or end marker.

name: copy_text_line_to_buffer
description: Reads a stored start position and width, then copies bytes from a text stream into a buffer until a terminator, carriage return, space or end marker, calling two routines along the way.

name: read_uppercase_line_input
description: Clears a sixteen-byte buffer to spaces, then reads characters until a carriage return. It converts lowercase letters to uppercase, stores each character in the buffer, handles a backspace code by moving the write position back, and stops once the length argument is reached.

name: run_artwork_and_cheer_sequence
description: Returns early when a flag is set. Otherwise it reads a character code, clears several state fields, and runs a sequence that references the First and PitBack artwork files and the Cheer sound file, setting the volume registers of audio channels zero and one while waiting for the video frame.

name: run_pit_stop_screen
description: Clears many state fields and runs a long sequence of twenty-two routine calls that displays the PIT STOP text, including a read of a character code. Its compare-based branches look like decoding artefacts, so only the calls and text are treated as behaviour.

name: run_frame_timing_loop
description: Repeats a per-frame loop that advances a 32-bit timer, polls input and state every eighth frame, and makes thirty-four routine calls for its state updates. The loop ends when its end condition holds.

name: stub_gap_fragment_calls
description: A two-instruction fragment from an unreached gap that makes two calls and has no other visible logic, so it may belong to a larger routine decoded in the wrong place.

name: set_lead_text_and_timer
description: When two state fields are clear, it points the text buffer at the IN LEAD label and sets a timer snapshot thirty ticks ahead of the stored counter.

name: set_lap_text_and_timer
description: Calls a routine, points the text buffer at the LAP TIMES label, and sets a timer snapshot forty-five ticks ahead of the stored counter.

name: select_positions_or_qualifying_label
description: When two state fields are clear, it sets a mode longword and chooses between the POSITIONS and QUALIFYING labels depending on a flag. It makes two routine calls on each path, then points the text buffer at the chosen label and sets a timer thirty ticks ahead.

name: toggle_blink_and_reset_timer
description: Inverts a toggle word, and when the result is nonzero clears two fields and halves a value, otherwise it doubles that value. It then points the text buffer at a shared buffer and sets a timer thirty ticks ahead; it is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: shift_value_and_reset_timer
description: Doubles a 16-bit value, points the text buffer at a shared buffer, and sets a timer thirty ticks ahead of the stored counter. It is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: call_routine_seventeen_times
description: Calls one routine seventeen times in a row and returns.

name: wait_counter_then_call
description: Calls a routine and, if its result is nonzero, calls a second routine, busy-waits until a counter word reaches zero, then calls a third routine.

name: invoke_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in order and returns.

name: run_four_steps_return_value
description: Makes four routine calls and returns a 32-bit value held in the data registers. Only part of its body is visible in the decoded output.

name: update_branch_by_state_flags
description: Chooses one of several update paths from state flags and two table words, then calls two routines along the chosen path. Only part of the branching is visible in the decoded output.

name: load_constant_pairs_into_tables
description: Writes constant 16-bit pairs into two fixed tables, filling one with a set of entries and the other with entries of a second set.

name: loop_table_entries_fixed_args
description: Stores a table-derived word and a constant, then makes fifteen passes over a word table, calling a routine with a fixed value of 160 and each table entry. It then sets two layout fields to 160 and 53.

name: blink_field_over_frames
description: When a field is nonzero, it runs twenty-six passes. Every fourth frame it polls a routine and negates the field when the result is zero, and each pass makes two routine calls.

name: call_routine_when_field_set
description: Calls one routine only when a field is nonzero, and otherwise does nothing.

name: run_fixed_pass_loop
description: Sets two layout fields to fixed values, makes fifty-five passes of three routine calls each, then resets the layout fields and makes further calls.

name: loop_table_entries_when_active
description: Makes seventeen passes over a word table. Each pass calls a routine with a fixed value of 160 and the table entry when a field is nonzero, and every pass also makes two further routine calls.

name: program_audio_channels_two_three
description: Writes period and volume register values for audio channels two and three, using state values and a set of routine calls to prepare them.

name: conditional_call_return_pair
description: Calls one of two routines depending on whether a flag is nonzero, then returns the two incoming register values unchanged.

name: dispatch_on_flag_long_body
description: Branches on a flag into one of two routine chains that together make ten calls, then returns the two incoming register values unchanged. Only part of the body is visible in the decoded output.

name: relay_call_keep_registers
description: Calls one other routine and returns the two incoming register values unchanged.

name: run_six_calls_keep_registers
description: Makes six routine calls and returns the two incoming register values unchanged. Only part of its body is visible in the decoded output.

name: wait_frame_then_run_steps
description: Waits for the video frame through the graphics library, then makes six routine calls and sets a limit field to 200.

name: call_two_routines_plainly
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, with no other logic.

name: loop_twenty_four_steps_reset
description: Clears a field, then loops twenty-four times making routine calls and checking a return value until the loop ends.

name: set_limit_around_call
description: Sets a limit field to 46, calls two routines, and then sets the field to 161.

name: set_limit_around_call_b
description: Sets a limit field to 46, calls two routines, and then sets the field to 161.

name: call_library_descending_thirteen_times
description: Makes thirteen calls through a library jump pointer, passing a counter that counts down from twelve to zero. The graphics library's wait-for-frame call is one of the routines reached this way.

name: update_quantised_level_index
description: When a status word is zero, it clamps a level value to 225 and shifts it down by four bits to get an index. When that index differs from the stored one it updates the stored index and calls a routine under one mode constant.

name: store_shifted_value_and_call
description: When a status word is zero and a value is nonnegative, it stores that value shifted down by eleven bits. It then calls a routine with the difference from a second field under one mode constant, and calls another routine.

name: swap_shifted_value_and_call
description: When a status word is zero and a value is nonnegative, it saves the previously stored shifted value and stores the new one shifted down by eleven bits. It then calls a routine with the difference from the saved value under one mode constant.

name: call_when_shifted_value_nonzero
description: Calls a routine only when a value is nonnegative and its shifted form is nonzero.

name: run_two_calls_under_mode
description: Sets the mode longword to one constant, calls one routine, switches to a second constant to call another, then restores the saved mode.

name: set_word_values_run_four
description: Stores a count of three and four 16-bit values into a parameter block, then when a status word is zero makes four routine calls.

name: run_two_calls_mode_alt
description: Sets the mode longword to one constant, calls one routine, switches to a second constant to call another, then restores the saved mode.

name: set_word_b_run_four
description: Stores a count of three and four different 16-bit values into a parameter block, then when a status word is zero makes four routine calls.

name: run_two_calls_mode_c
description: Sets the mode longword to one constant, calls one routine, switches to a second constant to call another, then restores the saved mode.

name: set_word_c_run_four
description: Stores a count of three and four further 16-bit values into a parameter block, then when a status word is zero makes four routine calls.

name: run_two_calls_mode_d
description: Sets the mode longword to one constant, calls one routine, switches to a second constant to call another, then restores the saved mode.

name: set_word_d_run_four
description: Clears a count and stores four 16-bit values into a parameter block, then when a status word is zero makes four routine calls.

name: run_two_calls_mode_e
description: Sets the mode longword to one constant, calls one routine, switches to a second constant to call another, then restores the saved mode.

name: set_word_e_run_four
description: Clears a count and stores four different 16-bit values into a parameter block, then when a status word is zero makes four routine calls.

name: run_two_calls_mode_f
description: Sets the mode longword to one constant, calls one routine, switches to a second constant to call another, then restores the saved mode.

name: set_word_f_run_four
description: Clears a count and stores four further 16-bit values into a parameter block, then when a status word is zero makes four routine calls.

name: xor_shift_store_word
description: Stores the exclusive-or of two state words, shifted left by two bits, into a third state word.

name: copy_masked_words_by_flags
description: Reads several state fields and table pointers to compute a source and destination location, then copies or masks 16-bit words depending on flag bits. Only part of its logic is visible in the decoded output.

name: read_pixel_from_four_planes
description: Computes a bit mask for a column index, reads the matching bit from four bitplanes stored 8000 bytes apart, and returns the combined four-bit value.

name: clear_bitplane_backwards
description: Clears a block of bitplane memory by writing zero longwords backwards from the end of a 32000-byte plane, in an unrolled loop that repeats for each block.

name: zero_block_backwards_by_count
description: Computes a destination pointer from a table entry and a state index, then writes zero longwords backwards through that block for a count held in a state field.

name: set_buffer_pointer_by_parity
description: Returns early when a status word is clear and a second flag is zero. Otherwise it stores a buffer pointer derived from a state offset, records a parity word, and calls one of two routines depending on whether the low bit of that word is set.

name: zero_rows_backwards_tens
description: Writes zero longwords backwards through a block in groups of ten, repeating for a row count held in a state field until the count passes below zero.

name: fill_rows_backwards_with_ones
description: Writes all-ones longwords backwards through a block in groups of ten, repeating for a row count held in a state field until the count passes below zero.

name: compute_row_offset_and_count
description: Derives a byte offset by multiplying a row index by forty, and a row count from the difference between two row fields minus one.

name: copy_block_of_longwords
description: Copies a block of longwords from a source pointer to a destination pointer, eight at a time over a thousand iterations. It is reached only from a gap in the decoded code.

name: blit_bitmap_via_library
description: Makes one call through the graphics library jump table to a bit-block transfer routine, the BltBitMap entry.

name: advance_pseudo_random_state
description: Multiplies a stored 16-bit state by a fixed multiplier, adds one, stores the result back, and returns the new state with its high word. It is reached only from a gap in the decoded code.

name: build_row_offset_table
description: Allocates a table through a routine, then fills it with running multiples of forty for each row. It stores the table pointer and a second allocation result in state words.

name: transform_plane_bytes_with_mask
description: Walks 64000 bytes in eight-byte groups, combining bytes from two buffers with a mask table selected by the low three bits of each position, and writes the results into a destination buffer.

name: dispatch_handler_if_in_bounds
description: Calls a handler chosen from a pointer table by an index only when the first value is between zero and 319 and the second value lies between two stored bounds.

name: dispatch_handler_by_index
description: Calls a handler chosen from a pointer table by an index argument, then returns.

name: repeat_handler_across_range
description: Calls one routine, then calls a handler from a stored pointer once for each step between a start value and an end value.

name: mask_pixel_word_four_planes
description: ANDs a 16-bit mask into the matching word of each of four bitplanes, which are stored 8000 bytes apart.

name: set_pixel_word_plane_zero
description: ORs a 16-bit value into the first bitplane's word and ANDs a mask into the matching words of the other three planes.

name: set_word_bits_plane_one
description: ANDs a mask into the first, third and fourth bitplane words and ORs a value into the second bitplane word.

name: or_two_planes_mask_rest
description: ORs a value into the first two bitplane words and ANDs a mask into the last two.

name: or_third_plane_mask_rest
description: ANDs a mask into the first, second and fourth bitplane words and ORs a value into the third.

name: or_first_third_planes
description: ORs a value into the first and third bitplane words and ANDs a mask into the second and fourth.

name: or_middle_planes_mask_ends
description: ANDs a mask into the first and fourth bitplane words and ORs a value into the second and third.

name: or_three_planes_mask_last
description: ORs a value into the first three bitplane words and ANDs a mask into the fourth.

name: and_three_planes_or_last
description: ANDs a mask into the first three bitplane words and ORs a value into the fourth.

name: or_first_last_planes
description: ORs a value into the first and fourth bitplane words and ANDs a mask into the second and third.

name: or_second_fourth_planes
description: ANDs a mask into the first and third bitplane words and ORs a value into the second and fourth.

name: or_all_planes_except_third
description: ORs a value into the first, second and fourth bitplane words and ANDs a mask into the third.

name: or_last_two_planes_mask
description: ANDs a mask into the first two bitplane words and ORs a value into the last two.

name: or_all_planes_except_second
description: ORs a value into the first, third and fourth bitplane words and ANDs a mask into the second.

name: and_first_or_rest_planes
description: ANDs a mask into the first bitplane word and ORs a value into the other three.

name: or_value_into_all_planes
description: ORs a 16-bit value into the matching word of all four bitplanes.

name: combine_rows_unreached_fragment
description: Copies and combines words between buffers in a loop, with pointers and counts set from several registers. It is reached only from a gap in the decoded code, so its complete behaviour is not visible.

name: update_bitplane_words_by_coords
description: Computes positions and word masks from several coordinate values and writes them into bitplane words, making two routine calls. Only part of its logic is visible in the decoded output.

name: update_bitplane_words_by_span
description: Computes bitplane word positions from coordinate values and writes them in a loop, making five routine calls. Only part of its logic is visible in the decoded output.

name: interpolate_span_values_a
description: Stores a starting value from a state word, then fills a span with values interpolated between two endpoints, checking for signed overflow at each step. It is one of several span routines that differ by the state word supplying the start value.

name: interpolate_span_values_b
description: Stores a starting value from a different state word and decrements it, then fills a span with values interpolated between two endpoints. It differs from its neighbours in the state word used and the decrement.

name: interpolate_span_values_c
description: Stores a starting value from a third state word, then fills a span with values interpolated between two endpoints, writing into a second array as well.

name: interpolate_span_values_d
description: Stores a starting value from a fourth state word, then fills a span with values interpolated between two endpoints, writing into a second array as well.

name: order_endpoints_and_index
description: Orders two 16-bit endpoints so the first is not larger than the second, then looks up a table entry by an index and combines it with a frame offset. Only part of its logic is visible in the decoded output.

name: dispatch_jump_by_offset
description: Calls a routine at an address computed from a 16-bit offset register, using an indirect jump that the decompiler could not resolve, and returns.

name: dispatch_jump_by_offset_b
description: Calls a routine at an address computed from a 16-bit offset register, using an indirect jump that the decompiler could not resolve, and returns.

name: clear_plane_words_unreached
description: ANDs a mask into four bitplane words, then clears a run of words in a loop up to an end pointer. It is reached only from a gap in the decoded code.

name: and_mask_all_planes_word
description: ANDs a mask into the matching word of all four bitplanes.

name: or_first_plane_mask_others
description: ORs a value into the first bitplane word and ANDs a mask into the other three.

name: or_low_planes_mask_high
description: ORs a value into the first two bitplane words and ANDs a mask into the last two.

name: combine_plane_bytes_in_loop
description: Loops over bytes of two bitplanes at offsets 16000 and 24000 bytes, masking and ORing each byte with values from registers. Only part of its logic is visible in the decoded output.

name: advance_counter_with_overflow_check
description: Adds two state values and checks for a zero result or signed overflow, resetting one counter to one when either occurs. Otherwise it continues to a further comparison, and only part of its logic is visible in the decoded output.

name: set_mask_bits_and_refresh
description: When a status word is clear, it calls a routine, then sets bits in several words of a data block using a fixed set mask, and calls a further routine.

name: set_and_clear_mask_bits
description: Sets bits in some 16-bit words of a data block with a set mask and clears bits in others with a clear mask.

name: clear_mask_bits_when_idle
description: When two status words are clear, it calls a routine and then clears bits in several 16-bit words of a data block using a fixed clear mask.

name: clear_mask_bits_in_words
description: Clears bits in several 16-bit words of a data block using a fixed clear mask.

name: reset_flag_and_run_three
description: When a status word is clear, it calls a routine and clears a second word if it is set, then makes three further routine calls.

name: call_routine_when_clear
description: Calls one routine when a status word is zero, and otherwise does nothing.

name: draw_vertical_span_in_bounds
description: Returns unless both coordinates lie inside a 320 by 200 area. Otherwise it calls a routine and then makes a call for each row from one coordinate to the other.

name: draw_font_glyph_at_position
description: For characters in a fixed code range, computes the glyph location in a font table and copies its bit rows to a position given by coordinates. Other characters are skipped.

name: forward_call_stub_b
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no logic of its own.

name: forward_call_stub_c
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no logic of its own.

name: draw_font_glyph_variant
description: For characters in a fixed code range, computes a glyph location in a second font table and copies its rows to a position given by coordinates. Other characters are skipped.

name: stub_return_only
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. It is called through a handler pointer.

name: set_flag_one_and_call
description: Sets a status word to one and calls a routine.

name: clear_flag_zero_and_call
description: Sets a status word to zero and calls a routine.

name: call_two_handlers_in_order
description: Calls two routines in order and returns.

name: clear_bitmap_via_library
description: Makes two calls, one of which is a library stub that invokes the graphics library's block-clear routine for a bitmap. It is reached through a handler pointer in data.

name: run_four_calls_sequence
description: Makes four routine calls in sequence and returns.

name: branch_on_result_sign
description: Calls one routine, then calls one of two others depending on whether its returned value is nonnegative.

name: adjust_palette_colours_rgb4
description: Reads a palette colour through the graphics library, passes it to a routine, writes a colour back with the graphics library, and makes further calls, repeating that pattern.

name: stub_return_only_b
description: Returns immediately and does nothing.

name: adjust_palette_fragment_unreached
description: A fragment of the palette routine that reads a colour through the graphics library, passes it to a routine, writes a colour with the graphics library and makes further calls. It is reached only from a gap in the decoded code.

name: adjust_palette_colour_tail
description: Reads a palette colour through the graphics library, passes it to a routine, writes colour entries with the graphics library, and makes several further calls.

name: adjust_palette_colour_short
description: Reads a palette colour through the graphics library, passes it to a routine, writes colour entries with the graphics library, and makes several further calls.

name: wait_for_video_frame
description: Calls the graphics library's wait-for-bottom-of-view routine and returns.

name: copy_sixteen_words_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from a block addressed by a pointer in a data table into a fixed buffer.

name: copy_thirty_two_words
description: Copies thirty-two 16-bit words from a block addressed by a pointer in a data table into a fixed buffer.

name: copy_longword_rows_when_enabled
description: When a flag is nonzero, copies groups of longwords from a source pointer into a destination block, then makes two routine calls.

name: load_palette_then_call
description: Loads a palette through the graphics library's colour-loading routine, then calls a second routine.

name: load_palette_then_call_b
description: Loads a palette through the graphics library's colour-loading routine, then calls a second routine.

name: copy_palette_record_to_table
description: Copies one palette record of longwords and words from a source pointer into a table entry addressed by a pointer.

name: clear_palette_block_by_flag
description: Clears either eight or sixteen longwords from a block, chosen by a flag, and makes a routine call on the first path.

name: load_hardware_colour_registers
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit colour values from a source block into the custom chip colour register bank. It is reached only from a gap in the decoded code.

name: save_longword_rows_when_enabled
description: When a flag is nonzero, copies groups of longwords from a source block back into a destination pointer, then makes further routine calls.

name: fade_colour_nibbles_step
description: Makes a routine call, then steps through a buffer of 4-bit colour values, decreasing each nonzero value by one and setting a flag when any value changes. The buffer length depends on a flag.

name: repeat_pair_calls_until_zero
description: Makes one routine call, then repeats a pair of routine calls while a counter argument is nonzero.
